title: App-surface timing and optimisation evidence
purpose: Record bounded local app-surface timing and fastest-safe optimisation decisions without adopting non-local tooling or weakening proof/evidence validation.

authorityBoundary.linearAuthority: Linear tracks work only and does not define USF semantic authority.
authorityBoundary.repositoryAuthority: This artefact records timing evidence and optimisation decisions for the bounded local app-surface tranche.
authorityBoundary.validatorAuthority: Validators enforce this artefact but do not create product, provider, staging, deployment, or readiness semantics.
authorityBoundary.generatedReportsAuthority: Generated reports remain lower authority than repository semantic artefacts, validator rules, proof evidence, and source implementation.
authorityBoundary.sourceImplementationAuthority: Source implementation does not define semantics and is not used to infer new app-surface behaviour.

fastestSafeExecutionNote.proposedBatchingPlan: Batch USF-1035 timing and optimisation evidence with USF-1036 closure gate because both are non-runtime, non-package, local proof/reporting work over the same completed implementation tranche.
fastestSafeExecutionNote.collapseRationale: USF-1027 through USF-1030 remain local/negative fixture surfaces, USF-1031 and USF-1032 are satisfied by per-slice tests plus consolidation, USF-1033 and USF-1034 classify Compose and staging as not required, leaving only timing and closure evidence.
fastestSafeExecutionNote.proofEvidenceOptimisationOpportunity: USF-PROOF-COCKPIT-009 now uses a squash-stable non-proof source tree hash from PR 331, so branch commits are no longer load-bearing after squash merges when the non-proof tree is equivalent.
risks: Full proof-cockpit re-pin still costs about 163 seconds when a proof-domain source change genuinely affects evidence.
validate-spec and validate-evidence remain broad repository gates and are intentionally not bypassed for closure.
Generated reports and implementation source remain lower authority and cannot define semantics.
willNotDo: No deployment or staging proof is created.
No provider, credential, store, push, ad, payment, production, compliance, or human-acceptance setup is introduced.
No Caddy port 443 or public proof routing change is made.
No remote cache, task graph tooling, or Testcontainers adoption is made.

timingEvidence.measurementPolicy: Measure only commands relevant to the bounded app-surface closure tranche; mark non-relevant or unchanged install/Compose timing explicitly rather than manufacturing work.

commands.acceptanceCriterion: Local install timing captured or explicitly marked not rerun with reason.
commands.reason: USF-1035/USF-1036 add no package dependencies and make no lockfile changes; frozen install was validated by earlier package proof and PR validation, so rerunning install is not relevant to this closure batch.

commands.acceptanceCriterion: Typecheck timing captured because a typecheck entry point exists.
Contract and local integration timing captured where tests exist.
commands.reason: USF-1031 and USF-1032 deliberately share the consolidation entry point to avoid duplicate equivalent test runs.

commands.acceptanceCriterion: Generated-client validation timing captured because the proof entry point exists.
Repository evidence validation timing captured because closure changes evidence-relevant artefacts.
Compose timing captured only if Compose proof is required.
commands.reason: USF-1033 classifies Compose as not required because implemented surfaces remain local, in-memory, static metadata, or negative fixtures and do not cross provider semantics requiring Compose.

commands.acceptanceCriterion: Closure gate planted-defect and positive regression timing captured.

optionEvaluations.currentDisposition: warn-only recommendations remain available through existing optimisation infrastructure
optionEvaluations.reason: Affected-run can reduce local operator time, but closure still uses explicit relevant validators and tests; it is not promoted to a hard gate here.

optionEvaluations.currentDisposition: not measured for app-surface closure because Compose proof is classified not required
optionEvaluations.reason: No implemented app-surface provider semantics require Compose-backed proof.
Testcontainers would be non-local provider/tooling adoption and is not required for local/in-memory or negative fixture app-surface closure.
Task graph tooling requires separate repository authority and is unnecessary for closing the bounded local tranche.
Remote cache would introduce non-local service semantics and is outside this authorised local closure work.
